svg.title: Intel GPU platforms
svg.text: Intel GPU platforms: our status (colour, first line; for video our verified scope) and what Intel's own Linux stack offers (second line)
sources: Linux xe/i915 display, Mesa device list, compute-runtime, media-driver f55f1c8ea764 caps tables; ours: evidence per cell (docs/PLATFORMS.md)
Kernel driver (GPU bring-up: GuC, engines, mem…

rect.title: Arc B580 / Kernel driver (GPU bring-up: GuC, engines, memory): works - IntelXe.kext: GuC 70.72.1 + SLPC, HuC 8.2.10, RCS/BCS/CCS x2/VCS x2 through GuC submission, VRAM, xe uAPI. Intel: xe (default driver) (linux xe_pci.c:414 bmg_desc (no require_force_probe), :536 INTEL_BMG_IDS)

B570, other BMG / Kernel driver (GPU bring-up: GuC, engines, memory): not yet - B570 (8086:E20C): matched since 0.1.4 (kernel/IntelXe/build.py IOPCIMatch, PR #2); Pro B60 (E211) and Pro B50 (E212): matched since 2026-11-13; none run on hardware; other BMG-G21 IDs: in the supported descriptor (kernel/IntelXe/xe_platform.cpp), not matched; BMG-G31 (E220-E223, Pro B70 = E223): matched, refused at start unless the tester boot-arg -intelxe_allow_g31 is set. Intel: xe (default driver) (linux xe_pci.c:414 bmg_desc, :536 INTEL_BMG_IDS)

Lunar Lake / Kernel driver (GPU bring-up: GuC, engines, memory): not yet - no kernel support; described in kernel/IntelXe/xe_platform.cpp (IP versions, firmware, what is missing), refused at start with a log line. Intel: xe (default driver) (linux xe_pci.c:399 lnl_desc (no require_force_probe))

Panther Lake / Kernel driver (GPU bring-up: GuC, engines, memory): not yet - no kernel support; described in kernel/IntelXe/xe_platform.cpp (IP versions, firmware, what is missing), refused at start with a log line. Intel: xe (default driver) (linux xe_pci.c:441 ptl_desc (no require_force_probe), :537-538 PTL/WCL IDs)

Meteor/Arrow Lake / Kernel driver (GPU bring-up: GuC, engines, memory): not yet - no kernel support; described in kernel/IntelXe/xe_platform.cpp (IP versions, firmware, what is missing), refused at start with a log line. Intel: xe, require_force_probe (linux xe_pci.c:386-388 mtl_desc .require_force_probe = true; :532 ARL IDs use mtl_desc)

Alchemist DG2 / Kernel driver (GPU bring-up: GuC, engines, memory): not yet - no kernel support; described in kernel/IntelXe/xe_platform.cpp (IP versions, firmware, what is missing), refused at start with a log line. Intel: xe, require_force_probe (linux xe_pci.c:352-358 dg2_desc .require_force_probe = true)

Gen12 Xe-LP / Kernel driver (GPU bring-up: GuC, engines, memory): not yet - no kernel support; described in kernel/IntelXe/xe_platform.cpp, refused at start with a log line; XeProbe stage 1 ran on RPL-S (row below). Intel: xe, require_force_probe (linux xe_pci.c:209-314 tgl/rkl/adl_s/adl_p/adl_n/dg1_desc .require_force_probe = true)

Arc B580 / XeProbe staged probe (docs/PROBE-MODE.md): works - stages 1 (identity) and 2 (forcewake) on 8086:E20B (xeprobe=0xe20b); stages 3-5 not run. Intel: - (kernel/IntelXe/xe_probe_ids.inc kIdsBMG)
B570, other BMG / XeProbe staged probe (docs/PROBE-MODE.md): same code, untested - platform descriptor BMG; not run on another BMG ID. Intel: - (kernel/IntelXe/xe_probe_ids.inc kIdsBMG)
Lunar Lake / XeProbe staged probe (docs/PROBE-MODE.md): same code, untested - platform descriptor LNL (GuC image lnl); not run. Intel: - (kernel/IntelXe/xe_probe_ids.inc kIdsLNL)
Panther Lake / XeProbe staged probe (docs/PROBE-MODE.md): same code, untested - platform descriptor PTL/WCL (GuC image ptl); not run. Intel: - (kernel/IntelXe/xe_probe_ids.inc kIdsPTL, kIdsWCL)

Meteor/Arrow Lake / XeProbe staged probe (docs/PROBE-MODE.md): same code, untested - platform descriptor MTL/ARL (GuC image mtl); not run; media GT store test not in v1. Intel: - (kernel/IntelXe/xe_probe_ids.inc kIdsMTL, kIdsARL)
Alchemist DG2 / XeProbe staged probe (docs/PROBE-MODE.md): same code, untested - platform descriptor DG2/ATS-M (GuC image dg2); not run. Intel: - (kernel/IntelXe/xe_probe_ids.inc kIdsDG2, kIdsATSM)

Gen12 Xe-LP / XeProbe staged probe (docs/PROBE-MODE.md): works - stage 1 (identity) on RPL-S iGPU 8086:A780; stage 2 refused as designed (another driver attached); stages 3-5 not run. Intel: - (kernel/IntelXe/xe_probe_ids.inc kIdsTGL ... kIdsDG1)

Arc B580 / Display: works - IntelXeFB: 2560x1440 180 Hz DP, 25 modes, VRR, HW cursor and gamma, link training; one monitor; hot-plug, HDR, DP audio untested. Intel: display 14.01 (xe2_hpd) (linux i915/display/intel_display_device.c:1526 gmdid_display_map)
B570, other BMG / Display: not yet. Intel: display 14.01 (xe2_hpd) (linux intel_display_device.c:1526)
Lunar Lake / Display: not yet. Intel: display 20.00 (xe2_lpd) (linux intel_display_device.c:1527)
Panther Lake / Display: not yet. Intel: display 30.00 / WCL 30.02 (linux intel_display_device.c:1528-1529)
Meteor/Arrow Lake / Display: not yet. Intel: display 14.00 (xe_lpdp) (linux intel_display_device.c:1525)
Alchemist DG2 / Display: not yet. Intel: display 13 (xe_hpd) (linux intel_display_device.c:1158, :1233 xe_hpd_display)
Gen12 Xe-LP / Display: not yet. Intel: display 12 / 13 (ADL-P, RPL-P) (linux intel_display_device.c:992 (ver 12), :1158/:1166 xe_lpd_display (ver 13))

Arc B580 / Vulkan (Mesa ANV): works - Mesa ANV over xemac; Vulkan CTS full run: 3.15 M cases, 1.77 M pass, 84 fail, no hangs; Vulkan Video decode and encode. Intel: ANV; Vulkan Video encode off upstream on Xe2 (mesa include/pci_ids/iris_pci_ids.h:278; anv_physical_device.c:362 hw_video_encode_supported = verx10 <= 125)
B570, other BMG / Vulkan (Mesa ANV): not yet. Intel: ANV; Vulkan Video encode off upstream on Xe2 (mesa iris_pci_ids.h:279 (B570); anv_physical_device.c:362)
Lunar Lake / Vulkan (Mesa ANV): not yet. Intel: ANV; Vulkan Video encode off upstream on Xe2 (mesa iris_pci_ids.h:261; anv_physical_device.c:362)
Panther Lake / Vulkan (Mesa ANV): not yet. Intel: ANV; Vulkan Video encode off upstream on Xe3 (mesa iris_pci_ids.h:291; anv_physical_device.c:362)
Meteor/Arrow Lake / Vulkan (Mesa ANV): not yet. Intel: ANV, Vulkan Video encode incl. AV1 (mesa iris_pci_ids.h:266, :272; anv_physical_device.c:362, :503 (AV1 encode verx10 == 125))
Alchemist DG2 / Vulkan (Mesa ANV): not yet. Intel: ANV, Vulkan Video encode incl. AV1 (mesa iris_pci_ids.h:239; anv_physical_device.c:362, :503)
Gen12 Xe-LP / Vulkan (Mesa ANV): not yet. Intel: ANV, Vulkan Video encode H.264/H.265 (mesa iris_pci_ids.h:194, :205, :218, :225; anv_physical_device.c:362)

Arc B580 / Metal: works - Metal plugin over ANV: WindowServer composites on it; mtl_tests 7/7; Geekbench 7 Metal 95.7k (0.1.4, macOS 26.7.1). Intel: - (Metal is Apple's API; Intel's stack is Linux/Windows)

Panther Lake / Metal: not yet. Intel: - ()

Gen12 Xe-LP / Metal: not yet. Intel: - ()
Arc B580 / OpenGL (Apple GL over Metal, Zink): works - Apple GL 4.1 over Metal and Zink over ANV: Minecraft 1.21.1 / 26.3 measured. Intel: Mesa iris (mesa include/pci_ids/iris_pci_ids.h:278)
B570, other BMG / OpenGL (Apple GL over Metal, Zink): not yet. Intel: Mesa iris (mesa iris_pci_ids.h:279)

Gen12 Xe-LP / OpenGL (Apple GL over Metal, Zink): not yet. Intel: Mesa iris (mesa iris_pci_ids.h:194, :205, :218, :225)

one device verified so far: the Arc B580 (8086:E20B); IntelXe.kext also attaches, untested, to the B570 (E20C, since 0.1.4), the Pro B60 and the Pro B50 (E211, E212). Evidence: docs/devices/b580.md
